name: Rennes car park availability and tariffs (Citedia)
short: Live free spaces and tariffs for Rennes car parks. Free, no key, ODbL.
summary: Rennes Metropole's open data portal serves a keyless Opendatasoft API with the live state of the car parks run by Citedia: status (open or closed), maximum and free places, coordinates, opening hours and a tariff grid by duration. On 2026-11-08 the dataset held 10 car parks (for example Colombier, 718 of 939 free); the processing timestamp was minutes old.

tasks: free places in a Rennes car park now
tariff for 1 to 4 hours in a Rennes car park
whether a Rennes car park is open

licensing.summary: Rennes Metropole lists the dataset under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0): you may copy, adapt and use it commercially if you credit the source, keep the database open when you publish an adapted database (share-alike) and keep the licence. The operator is Citedia. AI training is not specifically addressed beyond ODbL itself.
